# Logisim PLA program table
00000010 0000 # ADD
00000011 0000 # ADC
00000100 0001 # SUB
00000101 0001 # SBB
00000110 0010 # MUL
00000111 0010 # IMUL
00001000 0011 # DIV
00001001 0011 # IDIV
00001010 0100 # AND
00001011 0101 # OR
00001100 0110 # XOR
00001101 0111 # NOT
00001110 0000 # INC (ADD)
00001111 0001 # DEC (SUB)
00011010 1000 # LSL
00011011 1001 # LSR
00011100 1010 # ASR
00011101 1011 # ROL
00011110 1100 # ROR
